criteria.description: Acceptance criteria for 36.1, 36.4 and 36.5 (AC_0 to AC_3) are contract-testable pure functions. Stories 36.2 and 36.3 are run-and-check criteria. Two criteria in 36.5 (AC_4, AC_5) test a declared policy shape, which FDD-036 lists as out of scope, so where the shape is declared is not defined.
Stories trace to FDD-036 contracts, BRU-036 rules and ADR-036 sections, and each rule sits in one story's criteria (LL-012).

Six stories split the catalog, the 9 runnable examples, the 10 sketches, the ledger, the triage loop and the tailoring and propagation work. Policy declaration is in a story's criteria but out of scope in the FDD, a boundary mismatch to resolve.
